gap: No result ChatGPT got states what a hardwire kit adds to each 3-channel camera's price today: Vantrue N4 Pro S $279.99 plus Vantrue's $29.99 kit is $309.98, over $300, while VIOFO A229 Pro 3CH at $249.99 on amazon.com plus the $17.99 HK4 is $267.98; that $249.99 is also $50 below the $299.99 ChatGPT and Product Bible quoted.
standout_why: Compared against Product Bible's best-3-channel page (read in full) and EzDashcam's under-$300 store catalog. Product Bible prices the N4 Pro S ($279.99), N4S ($199.99) and A229 Pro 3CH ($299.99) as of Nov 19 but gives no hardwire kit price and no camera-plus-kit total. It also omits the A229 Plus 3CH and every DDPAI and Botslab 3-camera set. EzDashcam lists the A229 Pro 3CH at $309.99, which is over the budget. Vortex Radar returned HTTP 403 twice, so it was not compared.
decides: Camera only: the Vantrue N4 Pro S at $279.99 stays the pick and is a product we link (4K front, three STARVIS 2 sensors, under $300). If the $300 must also cover parking-mode wiring, which is the question ChatGPT asked the shopper, the N4 Pro S goes over at $309.98 with Vantrue's $29.99 kit. The under-$300 choices are then the VIOFO A229 Pro 3CH from amazon.com ($267.98 with HK4, 4K front, but a first-generation STARVIS cabin sensor per Product Bible) or the Vantrue N4S ($229.98 with the same kit, 1944p front). The N4S is in the Vantrue partner store but has no Dealectric record yet.
